items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: SPEAKER_04: 'Excuse me, there's a phone call for Kurt Gerdy.'

ctx.x: Excuse me, there's a phone call for Kurt Gerdy. That's me? Look, you can take it right there if you want to.
I can do better than that. Wait a minute. Here. Come sit down. Sit down over there.
